title: Coordinate differences and the homogeneous normal frame of an etale diagonal
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and let $U,V$ be affine finite-type $k$-schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $h:U\to V$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let $u:U\to\mathbf A^d_V$ be an etale $V$-map [def-weil-etale-morphism] [def-sbc-affine-space]. Put $W=U\times_VU$, $p=p_1$, and $\Delta=\Delta_h$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $x_i,y_i$ for the two pullbacks of the ordered affine coordinates. There is an open neighbourhood $O\subseteq W$ of $\Delta(U)$ and a section $s:U\to O$ with $\iota s=\Delta$ such that the difference map $e:O\to\mathbf A^d_U$, with coordinates $y_i-x_i$, is etale over $U$. The square with top map $s$, bottom map the zero section $0:U\to\mathbf A^d_U$, left map $1_U$ and right map $e$ is Cartesian. In particular its zero fibre is exactly $s(U)$ scheme-theoretically; injectivity of $u$ is not assumed.

Let $\mathcal I$ be the ideal of $\Delta$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], let $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$, and use the canonical graded multiplication map $\psi:\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to\bigoplus_m\mathcal I^m/\mathcal I^{m+1}$ of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]. Then $\psi$ is an isomorphism, and there is the normalized conormal isomorphism
$$\mathcal E\xrightarrow{\sim}\Omega_{U/V},\qquad[y(a)-x(a)]\longmapsto da,$$
where the relative differential sheaf is [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf]. The classes $[y_i-x_i]$ correspond to the ordered basis $u^*dt_i$. Relative spectrum of $\psi$ and this basis fixes a specific isomorphism $\phi_N:N_{\Delta/W}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf A^d_U$ over $U$, preserving augmentation zero sections [def-pur-normal-bundle] [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section].

For the extended-Rees deformation [def-pur-dnc-section-family], use any comparison satisfying [def-pur-rees-cone-normalization], whose existence is [lem-pur-rees-cone-normalized-existence]. Its zero-fibre coordinates, followed by $\phi_N$, are precisely $(y_i-x_i)/t$ modulo $t$; the degree-one formula fixes the same map for every normalized comparison. The map of deformations induced by $e$ has coordinates $t\mapsto t$, $v_i\mapsto(y_i-x_i)/t$, is etale, and has endpoint maps $e$ at $1$ and $\phi_N$ at $0$. These maps agree on smaller centred neighbourhoods and on open restriction. Under change of etale chart their normal maps change by the induced differential frame map. For $d=0$, one can take $O\cong U$, $\mathcal E=0$, and $\operatorname{Sym}(0)=\mathcal O_U$; the displayed maps are the identity data. Empty $U$ is allowed.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonal_difference_rees_frame (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine U] [IsAffine V]
    (aU : U ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aV : V ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aU] [LocallyOfFiniteType aV]
    (d : ℕ) (h : U ⟶ V) [IsSeparated h] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d h]
    (hk : h ≫ aV = aU)
    (c : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V) [Etale c]
    (hc : c ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V ↘ V) = h) :
    ∃ N : NormalFrame d h (fun i ↦ c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i)),
      Nonempty (CentredChart d h (fun i ↦ c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i)) N) ∧
      (∀ (C C' : CentredChart d h (fun i ↦ c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i)) N)
        (T : (pullback h h).Opens) (ht : T ≤ C.O) (ht' : T ≤ C'.O),
        ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpace).homOfLE
            ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpaceProj.preimage_mono ht) ≫
              C.deformation =
          ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpace).homOfLE
            ((pullback.diagonal h).ker.deformationSpaceProj.preimage_mono ht') ≫
              C'.deformation) ∧
      (∀ (c' : U ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V) [Etale c']
        (_hc' : c' ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin d)) V ↘ V) = h)
        (N' : NormalFrame d h (fun i ↦ c'.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V i))),
        ∃ M H : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) Γ(U, ⊤),
          M * H = 1 ∧ H * M = 1 ∧
          (∀ j : Fin d,
            h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ⊤)
                (c'.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V (ULift.up j))) =
              ∑ i : Fin d, M j i • h.relativeDifferentialsDerivation.d (X := op ⊤)
                (c.appTop (AffineSpace.coord V (ULift.up i)))) ∧
          (∀ j : Fin d,
            N'.normal.hom.appTop (AffineSpace.coord U (ULift.up j)) =
              ∑ i : Fin d,
                (PurityNormalBundle.projection (pullback.diagonal h)).appTop (M j i) *
                  N.normal.hom.appTop (AffineSpace.coord U (ULift.up i))))
